title: CrossSiteEdge
description: A cross-site lineage edge connecting runs across independent NovaFabric deployments.

edge_id.description: ULID identifier for this cross-site edge.

source_site_id.description: Site identifier where the source run was recorded.

target_site_id.description: Site identifier where the target run was recorded.

edge_type.description: Relationship type between source and target runs.

signature_ref.description: NovaSeal cross-site reference token; required when source_site_id != target_site_id.
